reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience! From the moment we arrived, everyone was incredibly welcoming, friendly, and professional. Asia, in particular, was exceptional! She has such a warm, positive energy and genuine enthusiasm that made our visit especially memorable.

What really stood out was how much the entire team seemed to enjoy their work. Everyone was attentive, courteous, and clearly took pride in what they do. I was especially impressed by the patience, kindness, and gentle approach they showed toward our Shiba Inu, who can be a bit cranky and particular at times! They handled his personality with such care and understanding, which meant a great deal to us.

We've recently moved to the neighborhood and couldn't be happier to have found such a fantastic place for our two pups. It's reassuring to find people who not only demonstrate exceptional professionalism but also genuinely seem to love the animals in their care. We're absolutely thrilled to have you nearby and look forward to many more visits. Highly recommend!
The practice is great. Dr. Smith is wonderful. Front office staff very friendly.
Everyone is friendly, informed, kind with my fur babies and efficient with my time.
Nice practice! The vets and techs are all very good.

I love Dr. Smith. She always makes me feel confident about my decisions with my cats and makes vet care less stressful. While she was out on maternity leave, Dr. Burbano was also wonderful. Great service all around.

I had an amazing experience with Dr. Pirok and her whole team. She was incredibly kind to Tulip and, at the same time, utterly patient with me as we navigate the somewhat stressful process of preparing documentation for summer travel abroad. Thank you to Dr. Pirok and the whole team at Northern Liberties Veterinary Center! We will be back and so appreciate the care and precision with which you treated both my pet and me!
Dr. Mateo is wonderful, caring, and honest. The techs, and the staff are also so nice and welcoming. Everyone goes out of their way to make sure you are cared for.

Great service and wonderful staff. The doctor and nurses were all very kind and professional.

My cat had a yeast infection in her ear, and they were able to see her immediately after I called. They were very upfront about the treatment and pricing, which I really appreciated.

After using the prescribed drops, my cat improved quickly.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and caring veterinary clinic.
Great staff, great facility, and great service! I recommend it!!

Came to NoLibs Vet for a second opinion on some masses my dog has, as well as to discuss overall health as he’s now a senior.
I felt very listened to, and also very informed as Dr. Burbano took the time to explain everything that was going on, as well as a range of options going forward. Also to note- the Dr actually got on the floor with my pup and did a nose to tail exam, something my former vet never did.
They were very up front about pricing for everything, and were very understanding of my needs.
Both receptionists, as well as the tech who took care of us (I regrettably forget her name!) were all very polite & informative. I would highly recommend NoLibs Vet & also Dr Burbano to any one looking for a new vet!

An incredible vet, we've been with them for ~5 years and they're always extremely fast to respond, super flexible with timing and appointments, and always make sure to follow up and be extremely kind and welcoming.

They have been the vet for my Boston Terrier since we moved to Philly 2 years ago.   We’ve seen Dr. Smith primarily who has been fantastic and thoroughly explained everything and patiently answered any questions I had during our visits.  We’ve also seen Drs. Pirok and Burbano who were also great!   Asia, Katalina, Amanda and Rynn are super support staff and are always friendly and lightening fast in responding to emails and calls and relay messages too and from the clinicians.  Their fees are very reasonable too and they have never run up the bill with unnecessary tests.  They are all thoroughly explained and well justified. I enthusiastically recommend NLVC for anyone looking for kind, thorough and compassionate vet care in Philly!
Great people here! Also they care about the pets and their owners. Won't go anywhere else
Dr Smith, nurse, and all staff were amazing. Above and beyond and exceeded my expectations! They took wonderful care of my Han Solo aka Mr Chonkie boy. Thank you!

Great place that offers great care for Pets and their family. Large, clean environment with knowledgeable, helpful and Compassionate staff. May 29, 2025 we had to put our German Sheppard puppy Zeus to rest, the staff was nothing short of compassionate. The staff really care for the animals. There is accessible parking and cremation option as needed. Thank You, Thank You, Thank You from Zeus’s Family.

Been a faithful customer since 9 years ago. I moved to the suburbs but continue coming here just because I love this office so much. Two cats, one dog. Prices are not particularly cheap but the staff is most understanding and never pushes anything on you. They LOVE animals, and the animals always know if you do.

My Morkie and I have been going here since 2018 and have always received outstanding care.  Just today, he was squeezed in for a sudden issue and the staff put me at ease.  Grateful to have these excellent veterinarian services in our lives.

I don’t usually leave reviews let alone bad reviews however I called this clinic letting them know about the crisis I am having with my kittens and upon doing so I was met with the response  “ call VEG they’re an emergency clinic that way you don’t have to tell me everything ” it’s nothing to have some kindness.I will happily steer clear from this clinic.
I been getting service almost 3 years and I have been very satisfied with the staff and the doctor who takes care of my baby girl all the time. I recommend them.

Worst place to take your animal, all they care about is money money money. I’ve been taking all 3 of my animals there since 2022, my dog has been receiving a cytopoint injection every year since then now I’m told she hasn’t been examined since 2022 and they would need more money to keep giving it to her. My cat went there and I was told he can be fixed up for $3500 when I told them I didn’t want to spend that money they said you have to put him down then. Place sucks Fishtown animal hospital is way better.
The vets and techs are great! They are informative and show great kindness and care for my cat's well-being.

I’ve been taking my dog here for a few years now and now I also take my puppy there - Dr. Smith is the best. She’s very knowledgeable and knows a lot about my dogs’ breeds. Whenever my dogs are sick, she takes the time to talk through all our options which I appreciate.
Such supportive and caring people!

There are no words to describe my experience at this Veg and the experience I had in Center City.

The atmosphere is so truly one of a kind. They allow you to be with your dog the entire time that provides a sense of security for both your animal and you.

They care about your animal as if it’s your own. My dog was seen at both locations due to different medical issues. Both times I was blown away by the service and by the people. I can write a novel about how amazing my time was and if they had a vet I would use them. I would drive to the other side of the United States for them to take care of my dog. They truly care about your pet and understand what they mean to you. Jaime gave me a bear hug consoling me when it was time to let my dog go. I can go on and on about Erin and all the other medical staff that assisted. Sami is very compassionate and you can tell is not only knowledgeable but empathetic as well. I truly know that if I ever needed an animal vet, I will be in great hands. Northern liberties place is great as it has parking that is close by. Not enough words to explain how this group of veggies helped me through losing one of my best fur friends. I love veg!
Excellent vets. I take my two cats here, and the staff are all very friendly and informative.  My cats are calm when they're there, so they're obviously doing something right!
Nice office, quick service and very helpful

Avoid this place if your pet is sick, only a okay place for vaccines. Also, one of their staff yelled at me yesterday at the checkout because I didn't answer her questions about the next steps and apparently handed her the wrong credit card (different from what she had in the system). She  yelled at me saying "do not raise your voice with me" when I was not raising my voice at all. She was verbally aggressive with me at my worst (was half crying because worried about my pet). I felt threatened and left.  Bad staff and very limited services. I regret having taken my pet there.

Please avoid that Veterinary Center if you  really care about your baby!
I called at the opening on Thursday to have an appointment for my baby that wasnt doing well, they told me they didnt have an appointment and recommended to go …
We've been taking our boy here for 2 years and we love No Libs Vet. They are so thorough, kind, accommodating, gentle and really make you feel like you and your pet are important. …
Just switched to No Libs Vet after a disastrous experience with another practice. Fantastic people and wonderful visit.
